name: 1129-needs-cycle
about: Two mods that need each other: neither starts, and each is named with the cycle (L800)

has.text: lt-cyc-a needs lt-cyc-b: each needs the next, in a circle (lt-cyc-a -> lt-cyc-b -> lt-cyc-a), so none of them can start first.
lt-cyc-b needs lt-cyc-a: each needs the next, in a circle (lt-cyc-b -> lt-cyc-a -> lt-cyc-b), so none of them can start first.
